author: Jray83_03
quote: It’s really cool to see South Florida fleshed out in such detail in a video game, but the graphics are ruined by the low frame rate. That’s about the only compliment I can give. The story, dialogue, characters all feel like it was written by ChatGPT. It’s bland, soulless, tedious and boring. Where is the personality and comedy? It’s a dating simulator in a GTA skin. Who asked for this? Even the sandbox element has been heavily watered down compared to previous titles. I intended to give a 6/10, but so many people are spamming perfect scores, it’s a con job. We need balance, so you get 0/10 from me.
